exercise: Run the focused swarm hook suite under the required Nix entry with SHELL=/bin/bash, including the raw-template CLI fixture whose deliberately invalid SHELL must fall back to PATH-resolved bash, controlled same-process and independent-process overlap, a held kernel lease, killed owner, stalled helper, and legacy directory lock path.

observed.crash_recovery: replacement delivery acquired the unchanged lock inode after SIGKILL
observed.timeout: stalled helper returned before the native hook timeout without polling
observed.legacy_path: directory and symlink lock paths remained present and caused no mutation
observed.raw_source_shell_fallback: the unexpanded @bash@ template resolved bash through PATH when SHELL named a non-existent absolute path
